paragraphs.source_en: Weary from days of exertion, Hideyoshi immediately had a tent pitched and a seat prepared, then removed his helmet and handed it to an attendant. “It is not yet noon, so it is still morning, after all... Ha ha ha! At last, we have achieved our objective before the morning was out.”

units.source_en: Weary from days of exertion, Hideyoshi immediately had a tent pitched and a seat prepared, then removed his helmet and handed it to an attendant.
units.source_zh: 疲劳了几天的秀吉立刻让人支起帐篷，安好座位，然后摘下头盔，交给近侍。

units.source_en: “It is not yet noon, so it is still morning, after all... Ha ha ha! At last, we have achieved our objective before the morning was out.”

ja.t: というものよ……ははは、ついに

units.source_zh: “现在不到午时，那就还是早上嘛……哈哈哈，我们终于赶在早上实现了目标。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 疲劳了几天的秀吉立刻让人支起帐篷，安好座位，然后摘下头盔，交给近侍。“现在不到午时，那就还是早上嘛……哈哈哈，我们终于赶在早上实现了目标。”

paragraphs.source_en: As he spoke, the warriors who had distinguished themselves so magnificently on the battlefield arrived one after another. Before long, resting soldiers lay everywhere from the woods of Shūfukujizaka to the village. Until then, their spirits had been soaring and they had fought valiantly for distinction, so they had scarcely noticed their fatigue. Yet the moment they stopped to rest, every man realized that both body and mind were exhausted beyond endurance, and they went limp as wads of cotton.

units.source_en: As he spoke, the warriors who had distinguished themselves so magnificently on the battlefield arrived one after another.
units.source_zh: 说话间，在战场上大展神威的武士们都陆续赶了过来。

units.source_en: Before long, resting soldiers lay everywhere from the woods of Shūfukujizaka to the village.
units.source_zh: 不久，从集福寺坂的森林到村落，全都躺满了歇息的士兵。

units.source_en: Until then, their spirits had been soaring and they had fought valiantly for distinction, so they had scarcely noticed their fatigue.
units.source_zh: 由于此前大家都豪气冲天，勇立战功，也没怎么感觉劳累。

units.source_en: Yet the moment they stopped to rest, every man realized that both body and mind were exhausted beyond endurance, and they went limp as wads of cotton.
units.source_zh: 可是一旦歇了下来，所有的人才感觉身心已经疲惫到极点了，瘫软得像团棉花。

paragraphs.source_zh: 说话间，在战场上大展神威的武士们都陆续赶了过来。不久，从集福寺坂的森林到村落，全都躺满了歇息的士兵。由于此前大家都豪气冲天，勇立战功，也没怎么感觉劳累。可是一旦歇了下来，所有的人才感觉身心已经疲惫到极点了，瘫软得像团棉花。
